verdict.rationale: Braintrust's own docs describe Loop, a built-in AI agent that investigates logs through natural language and builds scorers, datasets and dashboards. Loop can also generate datasets and run on a schedule through Patterns, so users can clearly hand tasks to it inside the product. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Loop's task scope, limits and in-UI workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of Loop's delegated task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Loop is Braintrust’s AI agent. It understands your data structure, so you can investigate your logs through natural language instead of writing queries.
Ask Braintrust’s AI agent to investigate your data and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards
Build datasets from production logs, user feedback, manual curation, or generate them with Loop.
Patterns puts Loop to work on your trace backlog on a schedule.
